title: 周三前不回应：就发传票？，黄仁勋被下最后通牒

segments.en: And then there's some things that are coming out of DC, we want to get to. So we're watching corporate, we're watching IPOs, we're watching DC.

segments.en: I mean, it just feels like this story continues to widen down in scope and perspective and it sounds like Jensen Wong might need to appear up on Capitol Hill. It certainly does. It is one area where
segments.zh: 感觉这个故事的范围和视角还在不断扩大，听起来黄仁勋可能需要出现在国会山。确实如此。这是一个我们听到两党成员意见一致的领域。

segments.en: we are hearing members of both political parties in agreement right now. Yesterday, there was a closed door briefing with the key lawmakers and both parties from both chambers with top security officials
segments.zh: 昨天，关键议员和两院两党的高层安全官员举行了一次闭门简报会。

segments.en: and they all came out of it, saying they wanted to address this in a serious way. They demanded more answers to questions, particularly what are the national security implications of this scandal?
segments.zh: 他们出来后都表示希望认真处理这个问题。他们要求更多答案，特别是这一事件对国家安全的影响。

segments.en: And it certainly seemed like it was something that Congress is going to dig in on in the weeks ahead.
segments.zh: 看起来国会将在未来几周内深入调查此事。
